items.title: Show HN: Lobby Domains: Find Domains with Chrome's On-Device AI
items.desc: description: Generate domain name ideas with Chrome’s ondevice AI and check registrations with RDAP. Free to use, no account required. Your brief stays on your device. title: Free Domain Name Generator & RDAP Checker Lobby Domains image: https://lobby.domains/socialcard.png [Skip to workspace](workspace) Find a Domain Name Describe it. Find a name. Make it yours. Checking Chrome AI… WebMCP activates in compatible browsers. What are you building? A little detail helps us find a better fit. 0/500 Try an example:Coffee shopFinance appDesign studio Find available ideas Extensions .com.ai.dev.app.org.net 1 / 8 selected. Choose up to eight extensions per search. More extensions (1,195) Search settingsBrandable · 12 names Naming style BrandableDescriptivePlayfulMinimal Available ideas 1 name3 names6 names12 names24 names Naming constraints Required words Excluded words Commaseparated letters only. Every required word must appear; excluded words cannot appear anywhere. Maximum characters Allow hyphensAllow numbersReset constraints Fresh ideasRescue a name Already have a domain? Check it Your domain ideas Your next name starts with an idea. Describe what you’re building. We’ll find names and check them with their registries. Unregistered is a registry snapshot. Registration, eligibility and price are not guaranteed. Starred shortlist (0)Compare & export Starred shortlist (0) Recheck shortlistExport CSVExport JSON Keep up to 24 names while exploring new searches. Choose 2–4 to compare. Exports include domains, registry status and check times; your brief is excluded. Star any suggestion or checked domain to keep it here. Nothing is saved to this device until you choose Save search below. Saved on this device (0)Save & revisit Saved on this device Saving stores your brief, settings, recent results and shortlist in this browser’s local storage. Up to ten saves, with the latest 200 candidates per save. No account, cloud sync or automatic saving. Anyone using this browser profile can open them. Search name Save search on this device Opening a snapshot replaces the current workspace and makes no registry requests. Recheck restored domains before deciding. Delete removes a save; it leaves the open workspace intact. Clear all local saves How it works Free domain name generator and RDAP checker Find a name for your business, side project or next product. Generate ideas locally with Chrome AI, then see live registration results as each name arrives. Start with common choices like .com, .ai and .dev, or filter the full bundled RDAP extension directory. Choose up to eight extensions per search, or check a domain you already have in mind. Can I share a search or use Back and Forward? Starting a search puts its description and settings in the query string. Available results update the same URL as they arrive. Only finished searches add browser history entries, so Back and Forward restore final results without rerunning AI or registry checks. Share search opens your device’s share sheet where supported; Copy link works as a fallback. Links include your description, settings, available names and check times. Anyone with a link can read them. Opening a link shows a snapshot; recheck for current registration status. Can I shortlist names or save a search? Star suggestions or checked domains, compare up to four names, and export your shortlist as CSV or JSON with registry check times. Choose Save search on this device to store your brief, settings, recent results and shortlist in this browser. Saving is optional and never automatic. Open or delete snapshots in Saved on this device, or clear all local saves. Recheck restored results before deciding. How do I refine an idea or rescue a registered name? Explore variations on a suggestion: more like this, shorter, easier to spell, or less playful. Naming constraints control required and excluded words, maximum length, hyphens and numbers. Rescue a name explores alternatives that retain the original meaning or sound. New suggestions are checked as they stream, and your starred shortlist remains available. How does the domain name generator work? Describe your project, choose your extensions and naming style, and set how many available ideas you want. Chrome generates names on your device while Lobby Domains checks each domain with its registry. The search keeps exploring new names until your target is met, or you stop it. Registry access or model errors are shown clearly. Is Lobby Domains free to use? Yes. Generating domain name ideas and checking registrations are free, with no account or API key required. Buying a domain is separate; Lobby Domains does not sell or register domains. Can I check a domain without using AI? Yes. Choose Check domains and enter one or more names with their extensions. Your browser checks registrations directly through RDAP, the Registration Data Access Protocol. You can use domain checking even when local AI is unavailable. Does an unregistered result mean I can buy the domain? An unregistered result means the registry returned a notfound response. Reserved, premium or restricted domains may still be unavailable to register. Unknown results, including network failures and unsupported browser requests, never count as available ideas. Which browser do I need to generate names? Idea generation needs a supported desktop Chrome browser with builtin AI and eligible hardware. Chrome may download its model the first time you enable it. Domain registration checking works independently of Chrome AI. What information leaves my device? AI generation runs on your device. The URL includes your business brief, settings and available results so searches can be shared. Anyone with that link, and the site host when it is opened or refreshed, can read those fields. Domain names are sent directly to their registries for RDAP checks, so those registries see each queried domain and your IP address. Optional named saves use local storage; completed searches ar
items.author: dalemhurley
items.descZh: Lobby Domains 是一款免费的本地 AI 域名生成与 RDAP 注册查询工具，它利用 Chrome 浏览器内置的 AI 模型在设备端生成域名创意，并通过 RDAP 协议直接对接注册局进行实时可用性检测，无需注册账号且能最大程度保护用户隐私。用户只需输入最多 500 字符的项目描述，选择多达 8 种域名后缀（可从 1,195 种扩展中筛选），并设置命名风格与词汇约束，系统便会流式生成并即时检测候选域名的注册状态。平台支持最多 24 个域名的本地收藏与对比，并可导出包含检测时间的 CSV 或 JSON 文件；用户可在本地浏览器中保存多达 10 个搜索快照，每个快照最多容纳 200 个候选域名，所有数据均不上传云端。搜索结果可通过 URL 链接分享，链接中包含完整的描述与设置，他人打开后可查看快照，但需重新检测以获取最新的域名注册状态，同时浏览器的前进后退功能可直接恢复已完成的搜索结果。该工具特别适合创业者、设计师和开发者在项目立项阶段快速构思品牌名称、检查域名可用性，同时也支持纯手动输入域名进行无 AI 依赖的批量注册查询。
items.quote: 使用 Chrome AI 在本地生成创意，然后在每个名字出现时查看实时注册结果。

items.title: Show HN: Firmenza – An AI employee for SAM.gov
items.desc: description: Firmenza&x27;s AI employee watches your SAM.gov registration and finds federal contracts that fit your business. Registration in SAM.gov is free at sam.gov. title: Firmenza — AI employee for SAM.gov and federal contracts image: https://firmenza.com/opengraphimage [Skip to content](main) Firmenza is a private company, not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Registration in SAM.gov is free at [sam.gov](https://sam.gov). Your AI employee for SAM.gov and federal contracts. It checks your record, reminds you before it expires, finds contracts that fit your business and answers your questions. What is your UEI or legal name? The check shows what SAM.gov lists publicly. Start Through October 31, your first Full Service order for a new registration or UEI only is free. [See what is included](/pricing) How it works 1. 1 Check See what your public record says. 2. 2 Watch An email before it expires. 3. 3 Renew Step by step, in SAM.gov's order. [How to register in SAM.gov](/guides/howtoregister) You do not need to pay anyone to renew. One renewal offer we found online asked $599 to renew a registration that is free at sam.gov. Offers like it are not from the government. [About paid renewal letters](/guides/paidrenewalletters) Sample, not a live lookup Tallgrass Hauling LLC EXPSOON0001B · Tulsa, OK Registration status: Active Expires Oct 9, 2026 · in 25 days Activated Oct 9, 2025Expires Oct 9, 2026 Today · 25 days remaining Activated Oct 9, 2025\. Expires Oct 9, 2026\. 25 days remaining as of Sep 14, 2026. Renewal due soonRenewal is required every 365 days. No NAICS codes are listedAgencies use NAICS codes to find businesses like yours. Fictional business and dates. The free health check finds no real public record for its UEI. How we work with you You keep your own Login.gov account. We never sign in as you. You answer every certification yourself. We explain each one first. Our prices, and when you get a refund, are on the pricing page. [See pricing](/pricing) No fee when you win a contract, and never more than a year paid ahead. We use your registration's real expiration date, never a madeup deadline. What your AI employee does Your registration Asks you SAM.gov's questions one at a time, and says what each one is for. Checks the format of each answer. On a renewal or an update, notes where an answer differs from your public record. Reads the documents you upload and proposes answers. You confirm each one. Puts your answers into a worksheet, in SAM.gov's order. Changing something midyear? The update mode asks what changed first, then shows only the sections it touches. [Changing your registration midyear](/guides/changingyourregistrationmidyear) Everything here but reading a filing or certificate you upload runs on fixed rules and contains no AIgenerated text. From a state filing or a certificate of good standing, the AI assistant may read the business's name and address; an ID or a contact card is read by Firmenza's own code. [Open the copilot](/copilot) Watching your registration Every day, rereads the public SAM.gov record of the registrations you watch, the closest to their expiration date first and as many as SAM.gov's daily limit allows. Emails you reminders from 75 days before the expiration date, with the real date. Near the expiration date, shows a checklist to get ready to renew, beside what your public record said. Tells you when a read finds a change: the status, the expiration date, or details such as the legal name, the address or the CAGE code. When you tell us a renewal was submitted, your watch list says so and waits for the public record to show the new date. Up to three more people can get a registration's reminders, each once they confirm by email. “What buyers see on your public record” lists what the record showed on our last read. The watch runs on fixed rules and contains no AIgenerated text. [Your watch list and reminders](/guides/watchlistandreminders)[Run a free health check](/check) Finding contract opportunities and grants Daily matches with SAM.gov's contract opportunities, by NAICS code, state and keyword, each saying why it matched. Keywords to leave out keep the notices you don't want out of your matches. Saved notices keep a private note and tell you what changed, such as a moved response date. A digest email of new matches and changes, once a day or once a week. “Before you respond”, a short checklist on each notice still open to a response, including whether your registration is active through its response date. “Explain this notice”, a plain summary from the AI assistant, drawn from the notice's published fields and marking what it does not state. The market view: who buys what you sell, from past contract awards in your codes. Also in the market view: contracts in your codes that end within the next year. Grant matches from Grants.gov, with keywords of their own, once you turn them on. New York City bid notices, matched by keyword, once you turn them on. Everything here but “Explain this notice” runs on fixed rules and contains no AIgenerated text. These are tools to help you find and pursue contracts, and the decision to bid is always yours. [Contract opportunities in Firmenza](/guides/contractopportunitiesinfirmenza) Ask Firmenza On Firmenza's pages, the AI assistant answers questions about Firmenza, SAM.gov and your registration, in English or Spanish. It answers from Firmenza's own guides, with links to read more. Signed in, it can also tell you the public status and expiration date of the registrations you watch. In the copilot, it answers about the section you are on, and can follow on from your last two questions there. It never says how to answer a certification. On size, affiliation, ownership, exclusions or lobbying, it explains the words and refers you to a free counselor or an attorney. Signed in, you can choose how it words its answers to you, such as shorter answers or numbered steps. Wherever it talks, its words ca

items.descZh: Firmenza 是一款独立的 AI 辅助工具，专注于帮助企业在免费的 SAM.gov 系统上管理联邦采购注册并智能搜寻政府合同，明确声明与美国政府或 GSA 无官方关联。其核心功能包括实时监控公共注册记录、提前 75 天发送到期预警邮件，并在官方系统内引导用户逐步完成注册续期与信息更新。亮点在于其高度自动化的合同匹配系统，每日根据 NAICS 代码、地区和关键词筛选联邦及地方标讯，并通过每日或每周邮件摘要推送最新机会，同时提供 AI 助手用英语或西班牙语解答合规疑问。在促销期内（10 月 31 日前），新用户首单 Full Service 服务免费，且最多可允许三人共享注册提醒，所有核心监控逻辑均基于固定规则，不含 AI 随意生成的申报内容。该产品主要适用于需要高效参与美国联邦政府采购、渴望避免高昂第三方代办费用（如避开索要 $599 的虚假续费陷阱）并防止因注册过期而错失中标机会的中小企业。

Odysseus lets you turn your GrapheneOS phone into a dumbphone, but with all the benefits of a powerful smartphone (maps, messaging, password manager, etc), and none of the [drawbacks](https://xxcancel.com/GrapheneOS/search?f=tweets&q=dumb%20phone&since=&until=&min%5Ffaves=) of a dumbphone. Download [](https://apps.obtainium.imranr.dev/redirect?r=obtainium://add/https://github.com/flourishtoday/Odysseus/releases) [](https://github.com/flourishtoday/Odysseus/releases) Verify your download with [AppVerifier](https://github.com/soupslurpr/AppVerifier): org.getflourish.odysseus FE:BB:57:70:19:90:D1:36:89:6A:ED:E8:DA:8B:3F:9D:62:C1:3F:0D:20:D2:AD:3B:E7:77:68:2A:B3:96:63:B0 How it works Click here to see how it works Owner is the manager. You use Owner to set up the daily user and to add or update its apps. Owner remains unrestricted to manage the device. Much of the setup Odysseus lets you create is based around GrapheneOS's [improved user profiles](https://grapheneos.org/featuresimproveduserprofiles). The daily user is a restricted user for everyday use. Odysseus creates it without the optional system apps, so on GrapheneOS it starts without the browser (Vanadium). It starts with a basic set: App Store, Contacts, Files, Settings, and Phone. You add the apps you want from Owner, then turn off app installs for the daily user. Once app installs are off, there's no way to add more from inside it. No off switch in the daily user. When the daily user starts for the first time, Odysseus blocks Private Space and debugging features in it, and hides its own icon. There is no Odysseus screen in the daily user to turn the restrictions off. Setup Before you start You need a GrapheneOS phone, a USBC cable, and a computer with [ADB installed](https://developer.android.com/tools/adb). Back up all important data off your device. You should do this even if you weren't using Odysseus, in case your phone gets lost or breaks. Android only allows a device owner on a phone with no accounts, no other users, and no Private

items.descZh: Odysseus 是一款面向 GrapheneOS 的工具，旨在将智能手机转化为具备基础功能但无浏览器、无法随意安装应用的“哑手机”，帮助用户减少干扰、提升隐私与专注力。它通过创建受限的日常用户，预装极简系统应用，并允许用户从管理端自主添加所需应用，随后彻底关闭安装权限，杜绝后续改动。该方案基于 GrapheneOS 的改进用户 profiles 实现，首次启动即屏蔽私密空间与调试功能，并隐藏自身图标，确保限制无法从日常用户界面解除。适用场景包括希望摆脱应用成瘾、强化数字隐私，又保留地图、消息、密码管理等核心功能的用户。其亮点在于将“可控的极简”与“安全的智能”结合，无需刷机或复杂操作，仅需 ADB 初始设置即可长期锁定使用状态。
items.quote: 打造一个 GrapheneOS 的日常使用环境，不装浏览器，不随意安装应用，只保留你选择的应用。

items.desc: There are several reverse terraform products out there. Some have paywalls, some are outdated. I wanted to try my hand at creating one that would start from nothing and produce an iac repo that plans, imports, and has a useable state. I'd love to hear your thoughts and feedback.
items.author: virtualbeck
items.descZh: 市面上已有多款反向 Terraform 工具，但部分产品存在付费墙或版本陈旧的问题。作者尝试从零开始构建一个能自动生成基础设施即代码仓库的方案，该仓库需具备计划、导入及可用状态管理能力。其核心亮点在于彻底跳过既有配置，直接产出完整可用的 IaC 项目，避免了传统工具的兼容性与成本障碍。这一工具尤其适合希望快速将现有云资源纳入版本控制的团队。作者在文中表达了对社区反馈的期待，以推动工具的迭代完善。
items.quote: 我想尝试创建一个从无到有的项目，并生成一个可计划、导入并具有可用状态的 iac 存储库。
items.titleZh: 显示 HN：继承 – 零到 Iac

items.title: Show HN: Weatheristic.com to answer questions other weather sites don't
items.desc: I built this for myself. I often have questions I want quick answers to such as "how cold did it get last night?", "I just put down fertilizer, when will it rain next?", "is today unusually cold or warm for this time of year?" Weather sites I tried made me dig for those
items.author: zievo
items.descZh: 该产品是开发者为满足个人对即时气象信息的深度需求而亲自打造的工具，旨在解决传统天气网站因信息过于繁杂而导致用户查找特定数据效率低下的痛点。其核心功能专注于提供直觉式的天气问答，包括查询昨夜低温、施肥后的降雨预报以及气温历史同期对比等。核心亮点在于将复杂的气象数据转化为自然语言式的直接答案，省去了用户在海量图表中筛选关键指标的步骤，实现了信息获取的极简化与高效化。该工具特别适用于农业耕作、户外活动规划以及日常出行中对微气候和异常天气有高频查询需求的个人用户。通过将气象数据转化为决策直觉，它能帮助用户在关键时刻快速做出精准判断。
items.quote: 我试过的天气网站都让我费力去查找那些。
items.titleZh: 展示 HN：Weatheristic.com，回答其他天气网站没有回答的问题

items.desc: description: Cybersecurity assessments, penetration testing, and PIPEDA compliance for small and midsized businesses in Kamloops and the ThompsonOkanagan. MadMoon Security [Shield](/shield) [Services](services) [Industries](industries) [About](about) [FAQ](faq) [nuwan@madmoonsecurity.com](mailto:nuwan@madmoonsecurity.com) The security you never wanted, because you never knew you needed it. MadMoon Shield — singleserver DDoS defense. No CDN. No CloudFlare. No external protection. One process. Patent pending. [Watch the Live Challenge](/challenge) [Learn about Shield](shield) — IPs Blocked — Attacks — Uptime — Status Services We focus on six things. We do them well. Security Assessment We review your systems, network, and applications for vulnerabilities. You get a written report with findings ranked by severity and clear remediation steps. No jargon. Penetration Testing Authorized, controlled attack simulation against your infrastructure. We test the way a real adversary would: web applications, email systems, network perimeter, authentication. Compliance & Readiness PIPEDA and BC PIPA compliance review. We identify gaps in how you collect, store, and protect personal information, and help you close them before they become a problem. Security Infrastructure For new businesses or firms undergoing transition. We design and implement your security posture from the ground up: access controls, backup, encryption, email protection, policies. Ongoing Monitoring Monthly review of your systems for new vulnerabilities, configuration drift, and emerging threats. Continuous protection without the cost of fulltime security staff. Incident Response If something has already gone wrong, we help contain it, assess what was compromised, notify appropriately, and rebuild your defenses. Available on retainer or ondemand. Why MadMoon Independent We don't sell IT products. We don't resell software licenses. Our recommendations are based on what your business needs, not on what earns us a commission. Local and available Based in Kamloops. We meet in person when it matters. We understand BCspecific compliance requirements and the realities of running a business in the ThompsonOkanagan. Researchbacked Our founder has published peerreviewed research and holds a BSc in Physics from Thompson Rivers University. We use methods grounded in real science, not offtheshelf scanning tools run without context. Rightsized We serve businesses with 5 to 150 employees. Our services are scoped and priced for organizations that need real security but don't need a sixfigure retainer. Industries we work with We specialize in businesses that handle sensitive client data and face regulatory obligations. Accounting Firms Law Offices Medical & Dental Clinics Financial Services Real Estate Professional Services Nonprofits Local Government MadMoon Shield DDoS defense that runs on your server. Not someone else's. One Process Shield runs as a single process on your machine. No proxy. No middleman. No routing your traffic through someone else's servers. Your data stays yours. Zero AI Every decision is deterministic and auditable. No black boxes, no model poisoning, no adversarial ML attacks. Pure math. Formally verifiable. Battle Tested We posted a raw IP address on the internet and dared people to take it down. 538 unique IPs. 342 attacks. 20,000 req/s. Zero downtime. [Watch it live.](/challenge) Shield launches in 24 hours Starting at $29/mo. No CDN required. Patent pending: GB2624368.3 [Get Early Access](mailto:nuwan@madmoonsecurity.com) About MadMoon Security is a cybersecurity consultancy based in Kamloops, British Columbia, serving small and midsized businesses across the ThompsonOkanagan and the province. Founded and operated by Nuwan Ambagahawatte, MadMoon provides independent, vendorneutral security guidance. We offer both consulting services and Shield, our website protection product. We assess risk, test defenses, and help businesses meet their obligations under PIPEDA and BC PIPA. Our approach is grounded in peerreviewed research and handson testing. We believe small businesses deserve the same quality of security assessment that large enterprises receive, at a price that makes sense for their scale. Expertise BSc Physics, Thompson Rivers University Published Researcher, IOP Nanotechnology Applied Cryptography PostQuantum Security Systems Vulnerability Research PIPEDA / BC PIPA Compliance Common questions Do I need to be technical to work with you? No. We write our reports in plain English. If there's a technical finding, we explain what it means for your business, not just what the vulnerability is. Will the assessment disrupt my business? No. We work around your schedule. Assessments run in the background. Penetration tests are scoped and scheduled in advance so nothing unexpected happens during business hours. How long does an assessment take? Typically 2 to 5 business days depending on the number of systems. You receive the report within one week of completion. What does it cost? It depends on the scope. A basic assessment for a small office starts at $500\. Penetration testing and infrastructure projects are quoted individually. We provide a fixed price before any paid work begins. Do you offer a free initial assessment? Yes. We offer a complimentary initial review for new clients in the Kamloops area. It's a good way to see whether there are issues worth addressing, with no obligation. Are you insured? We are in the process of obtaining professional liability coverage. Please inquire for current status. Get in touch Email [nuwan@madmoonsecurity.com](mailto:nuwan@madmoonsecurity.com) Location Kamloops, British Columbia Response time Within one business day Serving Kamloops, Vernon, Kelowna, Penticton, Merritt, and businesses across British Columbia. All engagements begin with a conversation. No sales pitch. We'll tell you honestly whether we think you need our help.
